role: Which characters typed text may contain (no section sign, no control characters, no DEL) and a filter that strips the rest; plus the characters forbidden in file names.
scope_reason: Only reached by typed text: chat, GuiTextField, world names, sign editing (world.conf sign_editing = off) and anvil renaming (anvil = off). The agent never types text.

members.name: allowedCharacters
members.note: despite the name, the characters disallowed in file names

notes: No native reference found in csrc/engine or csrc/play. If chat input is ever added to the native client, this filter comes with it.
